description:
Secure Infrastructure Engineer 
 Description - 
 Job Summary 
• As part of the team that implements secure authentication capabilities for HP print supplies, this role combines infrastructure deployment and embedded systems development to support a business-critical part of HP across R&D and manufacturing environments.

 Responsibilities 
 DevOps Infrastructure Deployment 
 Deploy and maintain Windows and Linux servers and virtual machines in R&D and manufacturing environments, on premises and in the cloud.
 Implement DevOps infrastructure projects as part of a team.
 Maintain and improve build and continuous integration systems to support efficient development and release processes.
 Develop and maintain solutions for operational administration, system and data backup, disaster recovery, and security and performance monitoring.
 Design and deploy complex automation, monitoring, and analysis solutions.
 Monitor and analyze system performance; collaborate with development teams to optimize and scale infrastructure to meet growing user demands.
 Conduct root cause analysis and manage incidents to address underlying issues.
 Evaluate existing systems against industry standards and recommend improvements.
 Embedded Systems Development 
 Develop embedded systems that communicate with secure microcontrollers over I2C.
 Troubleshoot communications issues using tools such as logic analyzers and a systematic approach to root cause investigation.
 Partner with application developers to integrate new hardware into software solutions.
 Apply embedded system circuit design knowledge and a security mindset throughout the engineering lifecycle.
 
 Education & Experience Recommended 
 Four-year or Graduate Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence.
 Typically has 4-7 years of work experience, preferably in software development, information technology, engineering environment, or a related field or an advanced degree with 3-5 years of work experience.
 
 Knowledge & Skills 
 Windows domain administration and Linux deployment, including server and virtual machine maintenance.
 AWS cloud infrastructure and Docker container technologies.
 Build and continuous integration systems, infrastructure automation, monitoring, backup, and disaster recovery.
 C++ for embedded systems development.
 Embedded system circuit design
 SQL Database management
 Cryptography experience and knowledge of security-domain principles relevant to authentication.
 Understanding of the engineering lifecycle, including development, testing, and maintenance.
 Ability to investigate complex technical issues and identify root causes.
  
 Cross-Org Skills 
 Effective Communication
 Results Orientation
 Learning Agility
 Digital Fluency
 Customer Centricity
 
 Impact & Scope 
 Impacts multiple teams and may act as a team or project leader providing direction to team activities and facilitates information validation and team decision making process.
 
 Complexity 
 Responds to moderately complex issues within established guidelines.
 
 Disclaimer 
 This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed in this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, skills, responsibilities, knowledge, etc. These may be subject to change and additional functions may be assigned as needed by management.
  
 The pay range for this role is $105,050 to $161,800 USD annually with additional opportunities for pay in the form of bonus and/or equity (applies to United States of America candidates only). Pay varies by work location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

 Benefits: 

HP offers a comprehensive benefits package for this position, including:
 
 Health insurance 
 Dental insurance 
 Vision insurance 
 Long term/short term disability insurance 
 Employee assistance program 
 Flexible spending account 
 Life insurance 
 Generous time off policies, including; 
 4-12 weeks fully paid parental leave based on tenure 
 11 paid holidays 
 Additional flexible paid vacation and sick leave ( US benefits overview )
 
The compensation and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. The Company reserves the right to modify this information at any time, with or without notice, subject to applicable law.
